wholePhysicalScope: Native building multipolygon 3358219 matches the named protected site, Wikidata Q1321720. Traced outer wall lengths, cloister and projecting major bell tower; the Spanish building-height raster controls roof and tower hierarchy.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the opposite towers, tiled wings and open two-storey cloister.
limitations: The perimeter, two tower positions, and roof hierarchy are grounded in the mapped and surveyed evidence. Individual roof breaks, opening positions on screened façades and fine carved ornament are representative.
The model covers the attached monastery and church block. The separate aqueduct, gardens, agricultural outbuildings, defensive tower and museum interiors lie beyond its extent.
